cheats.name: Speed up (force fast frame rate)
cheats.description: The game ships with a 10-step in-game speed setting (환경설정 > 속도설정) whose periods are 500/160/145/130/110/100/90/70/50/30 ms, but a fresh save defaults to the slowest step (500 ms, ~4 fps), which is why it feels sluggish. This forces the frame period to 100 ms (~20 fps) regardless of the setting. To use the game's own faster steps instead, leave this off and raise 속도설정 in-game.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: frame-limiter re-arm at 0x00106a8c computes timeout = period - elapsed, where the period is the speed-setting value in timerObj[0x7c]. Replace `ldr r3,[r4,#0x7c]` (load that period) with `movs r3,#100` so the period is always 100 ms. Tune the first byte for a different cap: 0x64=100ms/~20fps, 0x50=80ms/~25fps, 0x1e=30ms/~67fps.
